name: EverShelf
description: EverShelf: Your pantry's best friend. A self-hosted, open source smart pantry manager with AI expiry tracking, barcode scanning, smart shopping lists, and Android Kiosk support. Connects to OpenFoodFacts for product data (millions of items). Features include camera-based barcode reading, nutrition tracking, allergen information, and offline support for kitchen devices. For full features (barcode scanning, expiry reading, AI recipe suggestions), you'll need to configure environment variables in the .env file: - GEMINI_API_KEY: Get free API key at https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey for AI features - Optional TTS_URL/TTS_TOKEN for Home Assistant voice readout
